summary: Anthropic details Claude Fable 5's cybersecurity safety classifiers and shares an early draft of a proposed AI jailbreak severity scoring framework developed with unnamed partners.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to be re-deployed and now fully available to all users globally, implying restored/expanded serving availability.
mechanisms.quote: Claude Fable 5 has been re-deployed and is now available globally for all users.

practices.reason: The proposed Cyber Jailbreak Severity (CJS) scoring rubric with four axes gives a transferable method for grading jailbreak risk, though it is an early draft still being refined with partners.
practices.quote: In our proposed system, these factors combine into a banded rating on what we’re calling our Cyber Jailbreak Severity (CJS) scale: None (or “Informational”; CJS-0), Low (CJS-1), Medium (CJS-2), High (CJS-3), and Critical (CJS-4).
